title: Ancestrial Hall of Hakka Clan in Longgang (Hehu New Residence)
description: The Hehu New Residence Hall is the largest Hakka ancestral hall in China which is located in Longgang district in Shenzhen. Wenjun Zhong paid a visit to this mysterious heritage site and trying to find the trace of the early generation in Shenzhen in the 18th century.
